cloudAccess.error.reconnectingDescriptio.en: The server may be restarting or your connection was interrupted. We’ll try again every few seconds and reconnect automatically.
cloudAccess.error.reconnectingDescriptio.zh-CN: 服务器可能正在重启，或连接已中断。我们会每隔几秒重试并自动重新连接。

cloudAccess.error.unableToLoadDescriptio.en: We couldn’t check your access to this instance. Try again, or contact your instance administrator if this continues.
cloudAccess.error.unableToLoadDescriptio.zh-CN: 无法验证你对此实例的访问权限。请重试；若问题持续，请联系实例管理员。

cloudAccess.noBoardAccess.description.en: This account is signed in, but it does not have an active organization membership or instance-admin access on this Paperclip instance.
cloudAccess.noBoardAccess.description.zh-CN: 此账户已登录，但在此 Paperclip 实例中没有有效的组织成员资格或实例管理员权限。

cloudAccess.noBoardAccess.invite.en: Use an organization invite or sign in with an account that already belongs to this org.
cloudAccess.noBoardAccess.invite.zh-CN: 请使用组织邀请，或使用已属于该组织的账户登录。
